## Goal
The current AI Agent configures a user-level Starcat stdio MCP Server through Starcat CLI and completes read-only connection verification.

```text Name: starcat Transport: stdio Command: absolute path to Starcat CLI Args: ["mcp"] ```

```bash starcat mcp ```

macOS/Linux:
```bash command -v starcat ```

```bash test -x "$HOME/.local/bin/starcat" && echo "$HOME/.local/bin/starcat" ```

```bash starcat doctor ```

Claude Code:
```bash claude mcp add -s user starcat -- "<STARCAT_CLI_ABSOLUTE_PATH>" mcp ```

- Create only a user-level MCP configuration. - Do not modify project-level MCP configuration. - MCP transport must be `stdio`. - Do not put an HTTP endpoint in MCP configuration. - Do not request or configure a Local API Key. - Do not store a Bearer Token, pairing URI, or other credential. - Do not execute Starcat write tools. - Do not modify unrelated files.
